snippet.title: Crooked Cooks - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Crooked Cooks demo is out now on Steam!

Crooked Cooks is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op game where you and your crew run a restaurant as a front for the Boss’ criminal jobs, mixing fast-paced cooking with shady business.

Cook, complete missions, cause chaos, and try to keep the restaurant running.

Search for Crooked Cooks on Steam to play the demo and wishlist the game.

#crookedcooks #indiegame #coopgames #steamgames #funnygames
